===== en TITLE: CloudIVR — Virtual phone numbers, IVR & AI voice agents
SUB: Virtual numbers in 17 countries with call forwarding, voicemail, an SMS inbox, a press-1 auto-attendant, bulk IVR campaigns and AI voice agents. Call from your browser and pay with crypto or your wallet.
FC6: PRO AND UP AI VOICE AGENTS  An AI that answers your number or calls your leads in English, French or Spanish — it answers FAQs, books appointments, takes messages or transfers to you.
FC7: PRO AND UP TEXT CALLS  For deaf and hard-of-hearing callers: you type and they hear a voice; they talk and you read their words live.
FC2: EVERY PLAN CALL FORWARDING  Always, when busy or on no answer — to any phone worldwide, with up to 4 backup numbers. Billed per minute from your wallet.
FC3: PRO AND UP VOICEMAIL  Greetings in 5 languages or your own audio. Recordings and transcripts land in your inbox and email.
PA: 400 incoming minutes · 200 SMS included each month
REC: Call recording

  L: Extra usage is paid from your wallet: incoming minutes over your plan $0.15/min, SMS over your plan $0.02 each, calls forwarded to a phone $0.50/min.
